title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Earnestly Implementing the Spirit of the Central Economic Work Conference to Provide Strong Judicial Guarantee for Stable and Relatively Fast Economic Development
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Seriously Implementing the Spirit of the Central Economic Work Conference and Providing Strong Judicial Guarantees for Steady and Relatively Fast Economic Development

Fa Fa [2008] No. 41

The Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

This Central Economic Work Conference comprehensively analyzed the current international and domestic situation, clearly set forth the overall requirements and key tasks for economic work in the coming year, and pointed out the major principles to be grasped in economic work for the next year. This is of great significance for unifying thinking, building confidence, and overcoming difficulties. Seriously implementing the spirit of the Central Economic Work Conference and providing strong judicial guarantees for steady and relatively fast economic development is an important task for the work of the People's Courts at present and in the coming period. To this end, notice is given as follows:

1. Closely focus on the economic work tasks for the next year, and further clarify the work ideas and priorities of the People's Courts. People's Courts at all levels shall make implementing the spirit of the Third Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Central Economic Work Conference the central task in planning the work for the next year, conscientiously implement the two guiding opinions formulated by the Supreme People's Court on providing judicial guarantees and legal services for promoting rural reform and development and maintaining national financial security and steady and relatively fast economic development, and, closely combining the actual work situation of their respective localities, clarify the work ideas and priorities for the next year, so as to provide strong judicial guarantees and legal services for strengthening and improving macro-control, achieving steady and relatively fast economic development, and promoting social harmony and stability.

2. Closely monitor new changes in the economy and society, and achieve the organic unity of applying the law and implementing policies. People's Courts at all levels shall enhance their ability to predict the development trends of various sensitive issues and their ability to handle difficult and complex issues, closely monitor new situations and new changes in the economic and social environment, conduct in-depth forward-looking investigation and research, summarize trial experience in a timely manner, and study and formulate judicial policies and guiding opinions. They shall strengthen the supervision and guidance of the handling of major and important cases, timely study and properly handle in accordance with the law cases that may contain factors affecting social harmony and stability, such as group cases, class action cases, and bankruptcy cases, and strive to improve the ability to provide professional supervision and guidance to lower-level courts.

3. Closely monitor new situations that may arise in public security, and further give play to the functional role of the People's Courts in punishing crime and resolving conflicts. They shall give full play to the function of criminal adjudication, lawfully combat and punish crimes endangering national security, terrorist crimes, violent crimes, and organized crimes of a mafia-style nature, severely punish various economic crimes, actively carry out special operations such as combating organized crime and eliminating vice, drug control and gambling prohibition, and tackling commercial bribery, so as to create a safe and stable development environment. They shall give full play to the function of civil adjudication, lawfully regulate economic and social relations, resolve social conflicts and disputes, maintain the order of the socialist market economy, and create a stable and harmonious social environment. They shall give full play to the function of administrative adjudication, support and supervise administrative organs in lawfully exercising their powers, protect the legitimate rights and interests of the people, promote the implementation of macroeconomic control policies, serve the construction of a law-based government, and create a convenient and efficient service environment. They shall give full play to the function of adjudication supervision and compulsory enforcement, properly handle litigation-related petitions, safeguard the unity, dignity, and authority of the national legal system, and create a fair and just legal environment.

4. Closely monitor hot and difficult issues concerning the interests of the masses, and continuously improve the level of judicial guarantees and legal services. They shall further strengthen mediation and promote conciliation, improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism, and continuously enhance the ability of the People's Courts to resolve conflicts and disputes. They shall effectively improve judicial efficiency, give full play to the function of summary procedures, accelerate the research and exploration of fast-track adjudication mechanisms, and resolve conflicts and disputes in a timely manner. They shall increase the intensity of judicial assistance, improve the conditions, standards, and procedures for deferring, reducing, or exempting litigation costs for parties with financial difficulties, and strive to meet the judicial needs of society. They shall strengthen the work of judicial suggestions, and for new situations and new problems discovered in trial work, promptly propose countermeasures and suggestions to the relevant departments. They shall strengthen judicial publicity work; for cases involving disruption of the order of the national economy and social stability, after the trial is concluded, they shall conduct extensive publicity through timely press conferences, publication of typical cases, organization of special or series reports, and other means, to educate and guide various market entities to enhance their awareness of lawful operation and risk prevention, and give full play to the social guiding role of trial work.

5. Closely monitor the new tests facing the work of the People's Courts, and strive to achieve the scientific development of the People's Courts themselves. In accordance with the work policy of "strictly governing the courts, establishing credibility through the courts, and strengthening the courts through science and technology," they shall further strengthen the self-construction of the People's Courts. They shall unremittingly strengthen anti-corruption education, improve the awareness and ability of the vast number of judicial police to maintain integrity and resist corruption. They shall vigorously strengthen the construction of grassroots infrastructure, effectively enhance the strength of grassroots courts, stimulate their vitality, improve their efficiency, and build a solid first line of defense for maintaining social harmony and stability. They shall solidly advance judicial management work, and establish a scientific, reasonable, simple, and effective judicial evaluation system. They shall solidly advance judicial theoretical research, and strive to cultivate a high-quality theoretical research team to promote the common development of judicial theory and practice. They shall solidly advance the construction of judicial capacity, and enhance judges' ability to solve practical problems and resolve conflicts and disputes.

December 12, 2008
